propositions: BindingStore currently embeds forward/reverse identity transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, and unretire policy that must be extracted into a private binding_lifecycle.py policy owner
Production rich-text convergence reaches through shallow all_bindings() and mutates inner dictionaries, bypassing future policy seams, requiring a narrow facade operation for supported mutation

Lifecycle operations must preserve at-most-one identity through targeted single-key reverse pops and maintain exact current failure modes (confirmed 404 grace/reset, moved-key repair, retired corruption fail-open, live corruption fail-closed, append-only comment identity, tombstone suppression)

The public BindingStore facade must retain all existing method signatures and shallow all_bindings() semantics while a new narrow operation (note_rich_emit or equivalent) becomes the supported production mutation seam
